text:
maya: Quick sync — I opened a docs PR for quota & pricing docs (dashboard panels + SDK meter header sample). Looking for reviewers for wording on 'burst credits' and the new 'metering' header example.

owen: linking the PR?

maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 (draft). Main changes: renames panel id from cpu_quota to quota_utilization_v2, moves pricing tiers under /pricing/tiers, and adds SDK snippet for metering header.

linh: I noticed the dashboard uses metric name `redwood.quota.usage` in prod, not `quota_utilization_v2`. We should confirm the query before merging.

chris: correct — dashboards in prod (us-east) are still on the old metric. If we change the panel id we need to add a migration note so SRE/Analytics don't lose links. Also update panel JSON import file.

maya: good catch. I'll add a small migration guide section and a note in the PR description. @chris can you paste the exact prod metric name?

chris: it's `redwood.quota.usage` with labels {region, plan}. Example: `sum by(plan) (rate(redwood_quota_usage_total[5m]))`

ben (SDK): for the SDK snippet I'm proposing this header example:

```
client.headers['x-redwood-metering'] = 'plan=pro; tier=standard; window=30d'
resp = client.generate(...)
```

maya: That's the snippet. Want to ensure it's accurate for both Python and Node examples. Ben, can you add the Node variant? Also we need to show how to parse it in analytics.

ben (SDK): sure. Node variant:

```js
sdk.setHeader('x-redwood-metering', 'plan=pro;tier=standard;window=30d')
await sdk.text.generate(...)
```

owen: tiny wording nit — 'tier' -> 'billing_tier' in docs to match our analytics schema.

maya: updated the PR to use billing_tier. Also added a short migration subsection: "If dashboards reference `quota_utilization_v2`, update to `redwood.quota.usage` and re-import panel JSON." I'll ping infra to sync.

docs-ci-bot: docs CI failed — linkcheck errors in /pricing/tiers (broken anchor) :eyes: https://ci.redwood-inference/docs/482

maya: On it, fixing the anchor and local link. Will re-run CI.

linh: once CI passes I'd like a quick smoke — run the dashboard import locally and verify queries.

maya: plan: fix anchor, add migration note, Ben adds Node snippet, Chris verifies metric, Linh does smoke. Target merge: EOD tomorrow. Thanks all :rocket:
